## Cloud service launches (Platform; G-cluster, d game)
- The `android` and `apple` rows ("d game Play Ticket cloud") sit on the primary, the 2014 Remaster, the Windows build G-cluster streamed (our matching, no source names the build); struck, with no link, since the service had no app or page of its own; it ran only on those device families (a browser on iPhone, iPad and Android phones and tablets, per the sources), so the platform rows are Android and iOS, not the browser key

- Phone app (Android and iOS): 2015-04-10, per the phone app news page (https://web.archive.org/web/20250114083821/https://gcluster.jp/sp/app/sqex/news.html)
- Apple TV: 2016-06-20 (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/pdf/20160620_001.pdf); the same App Store app as the iPhone and iPad one (id960145054), one Apple ID syncs the saves, and a controller is needed
- Amazon Android app store (Fire TV, Fire TV Stick, Fire tablets, Android phones): 2016-04-27, one of five apps released together (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/dock/20160428-001_01.pdf; Amazon's campaign page https://www.amazon.co.jp/se2016 has no capture); saves sync through one Amazon account; a Fire TV Stick needs the Amazon Fire TV game controller
- Android TV (Sony BRAVIA, 2015 and 2016 models): 2017-04-11 (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/2017/04/11-001516.html); saves sync through one Google account with the Google Play app
- au Game (KDDI): sold there until 2023-05-15, then buyers moved to the Google Play version (the news page's notice of 2023-02-28)
- J:COM Game (Smart J:COM Box): 2017-03-15, details below; the service ended 2025-01-31; the same G-cluster phone app as the `android` and `apple` rows, shown on the TV through the box; the box cannot start XIII alone, the phone with the app is always needed, so it works like a Steam Link, and it adds no platform row of its own (user, 2026-10-23)
  - J:COM Game: cable-TV game service, a 500 yen a month plan of 40+ games; its last front-page capture, https://web.archive.org/web/20250115183959/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/index.shtml (2025-01-15), carries the notice that it ends on Friday 31 January (2025)
  - News item of 2017-03-15 on the service page (https://web.archive.org/web/20170815122856/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/, user-pasted 2026-10-22): phone-app linkage with the TV starts on the Smart J:COM Box, with FINAL FANTASY XIII as the supported title; the only FF named; the capture's game lists do not show it
  - XIII's own page, https://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/ff13/index.shtml (user-pasted 2026-10-23; archived: TODO): the G-cluster phone and tablet app (App Store id960145054, Google Play jp.co.sqex.game.ff13, provider Broadmedia GC, Android 4.2 or later, iOS 8.1 or later) shown on the TV through the box
    - The box shows an 8-digit code, the phone enters it, the phone becomes the controller (or a Logicool F710 gamepad)
    - The app is bought separately; the link costs nothing extra and does not need the unlimited plan; the first link needs the app's 30-minute trial played once
    - XIII has no menu in the service's own game screen; the page says nothing about what the box runs, so it is not shown to be an Android TV device
  - The plan's game list (packgame.shtml, user-checked 2026-10-22) lists no FF: first working capture https://web.archive.org/web/20160109204143/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/packgame.shtml; last capture that displays games https://web.archive.org/web/20160915222410/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/packgame.shtml (2016-09-15); last capture https://web.archive.org/web/20170904011258/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/packgame.shtml (2017-09-04) shows no games
  - The page loads its games from csv/gamedata.csv, read from the raw capture (the file served was a later copy, with titles dated to 2019-05-16): 94 rows (82 pack games, 12 free), no FF in any title or text, 24 rows blanked as "公開終了" (ended); so XIII was not one of the plan's or free games, though the blanked rows cannot be ruled out
  - Front page (user-checked 2026-10-23): no FF in the first capture, https://web.archive.org/web/20151104234116/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/index.shtml (2015-11-04), or in the last one before the shutdown notice, https://web.archive.org/web/20190716100745/http://www2.myjcom.jp/special/jcom_game/index.shtml (2019-07-16)
- Amazon.co.jp reviews of the G-cluster box alone (ASIN B00CXJPJUC, https://web.archive.org/web/20220923040537/https://www.amazon.co.jp/dp/B00CXJPJUC, user-pasted 2026-10-22): 2020-04-16 played XIII on an iPhone XR; 2020-12-16 says XIII was bought at once on the monthly plan; neither says which device ran the game, so corroboration only
- d game Play Ticket: in the browser from 2020-03-18 (https://www.broadmedia.co.jp/news/2020/03/18-001869.html), one of the launch titles (Famitsu quotes the release, https://www.famitsu.com/news/202003/18194848.html: a browser on iPhone, iPad and Android, which backs the Android and iOS rows); Den Faminico Gamer (https://news.denfaminicogamer.jp/news/200318d, user, 2026-10-22) lists XIII as on sale at the 2020-03-18 launch, which confirms the date; new sales stopped 2022-12-26 and the service ended 2023-09-27 at 14:00 (https://www.docomo.ne.jp/info/news_release/2023/01/16_00.html; Game Watch, https://game.watch.impress.co.jp/docs/news/1470536.html, 2023-01-16)
  - Service page http://www.dmkt-sp.jp/g/ (user, 2026-10-22): the 2015-02-22 capture (https://web.archive.org/web/20150222193658/http://www.dmkt-sp.jp/g/) is an invitation page that predates the cloud service; the 2017-05-12 (https://web.archive.org/web/20170512075731/http://www.dmkt-sp.jp/g/) and last, 2023-04-06 (https://web.archive.org/web/20230406161147/http://www.dmkt-sp.jp/g/), captures redirect to the portal's game store
  - The game store (http://portal.dmkt-sp.jp/sp/game-store/top/ behind `?url=`): captures of 2017-05-12 (https://web.archive.org/web/20170512075731/https://www.dmkt-sp.jp/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fportal.dmkt-sp.jp%2Fsp%2Fgame-store%2Ftop), 2020-06-08, 2020-11-30 (https://web.archive.org/web/20201130104036/https://www.dmkt-sp.jp/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fportal.dmkt-sp.jp%2Fsp%2Fgame-store%2Ftop) and 2021-01-29 do not list this game (the store does list Chocobo's Chocotto Farm in captures of 2016-10-12 and 2017-10-17, see sources/chocobo-series-1997.md); the 2023-04-11 capture (https://web.archive.org/web/20230411091257/https://www.dmkt-sp.jp/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fportal.dmkt-sp.jp%2Fsp%2Fgame-store%2Ftop) was not read; the portal address itself has no working capture
  - Dead end: no capture of the official page lists the game; the releases and news posts name the service and its URL as where it is live, so the titles are probably shown only after signing in to the service itself (inference)
  - No source names a PC browser
